about: Lincoln is a town in Niagara Region, Ontario, on Lake Ontario between Grimsby and St. Catharines. It covers Beamsville, Vineland, Jordan, and lakeshore countryside in the heart of Niagara’s wine and tender-fruit belt. Vineyards, escarpment brow roads, and orchard villages define the municipality more than a single dense downtown. About 26,000 people live in Lincoln.
